item.title: Circular Saw Straight-Edge Guide for Plywood
item.description: Build or use a circular-saw guide by measuring blade offset, supporting the sheet, controlling splinters, and testing the guide before final cuts.

item.title: Table Saw Fence Alignment for Accurate Plywood Rips
item.description: Check fence parallelism, blade condition, support, feed pressure, riving knife, and measurement before repeating cabinet-width plywood rips.

item.title: Track Saw First Cut: Create a Straight Plywood Reference Edge
item.description: Make the first track-saw cut establish a clean reference edge before parallel rips, crosscuts, labels, and final-size cabinet parts.
